verses.en: The king’s heart is in the hand of the LORD, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.
verses.pt: Como ribeiros de águas é o coração do rei na mão do SENHOR, ele o conduz para onde quer.
verses.en_web: The king’s heart is in Yahweh’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.
verses.en_bbe: The king's heart in the hands of the Lord is like the water streams, and by him it is turned in any direction at his pleasure.

verses.en: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but the LORD pondereth the hearts.
verses.pt: Todo caminho do homem é correto aos seus próprios olhos; mas o SENHOR pesa os corações.
verses.en_web: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but Yahweh weighs the hearts.
verses.en_bbe: Every way of a man seems right to himself, but the Lord is the tester of hearts.

verses.en: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.
verses.pt: Praticar justiça e juízo é mais aceitável ao SENHOR do que sacrifício.
verses.en_web: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice.
verses.en_bbe: To do what is right and true is more pleasing to the Lord than an offering.

verses.en: An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.
verses.pt: Olhos orgulhosos e coração arrogante: a lavoura dos perversos é pecado.
verses.en_web: A high look, and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.
verses.en_bbe: A high look and a heart of pride, *** of the evil-doer is sin.

verses.en: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.
verses.pt: Os planos de quem trabalha com empenho somente levam à abundância; mas os de todo apressado somente à pobreza.
verses.en_web: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.
verses.en_bbe: The purposes of the man of industry have their outcome only in wealth; but one who is over-quick in acting will only come to be in need.

verses.en: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.
verses.pt: Trabalhar para obter tesouros com língua mentirosa é algo inútil e fácil de se perder; os que assim fazem buscam a morte.
verses.en_web: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.
verses.en_bbe: He who gets stores of wealth by a false tongue, is going after what is only breath, and searching for death.

verses.en: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.
verses.pt: A violência praticada pelos perversos os destruirá, porque se negam a fazer o que é justo.
verses.en_web: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.
verses.en_bbe: By their violent acts the evil-doers will be pulled away, because they have no desire to do what is right.

verses.en: The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.
verses.pt: O caminho do homem transgressor é problemático; porém a obra do puro é correta.
verses.en_web: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.
verses.en_bbe: Twisted is the way of him who is full of crime; but as for him whose heart is clean, his work is upright.

verses.en: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.
verses.pt: É melhor morar num canto do terraço do que numa casa espaçosa com uma mulher briguenta.
verses.en_web: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, than to share a house with a contentious woman.
verses.en_bbe: It is better to be living in an angle of the house-top, than with a bitter-tongued woman in a wide house.

verses.en: The soul of the wicked desireth evil: his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.
verses.pt: A alma do perverso deseja o mal; seu próximo não lhe agrada em seus olhos.
verses.en_web: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.
verses.en_bbe: The desire of the evil-doer is fixed on evil: he has no kind feeling for his neighbour.

verses.en: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.
verses.pt: Castigando ao zombador, o ingênuo se torna sábio; e ensinando ao sábio, ele ganha conhecimento.
verses.en_web: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.
verses.en_bbe: When the man of pride undergoes punishment, the simple man gets wisdom; and by watching the wise he gets knowledge.

verses.en: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.
verses.pt: O justo considera prudentemente a casa do perverso; ele transtorna os perversos para a ruína.
verses.en_web: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.
verses.en_bbe: The Upright One, looking on the house of the evil-doer, lets sinners be overturned to their destruction.

verses.en: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.
verses.pt: Quem tapa seu ouvido ao clamor do pobre, ele também clamará, mas não será ouvido.
verses.en_web: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.
verses.en_bbe: He whose ears are stopped at the cry of the poor, will himself get no answer to his cry for help.

verses.en: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.
verses.pt: O presente em segredo extingue a ira; e a dádiva no colo acalma o forte furor.
verses.en_web: A gift in secret pacifies anger; and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.
verses.en_bbe: By a secret offering wrath is turned away, and the heat of angry feelings by money in the folds of the robe.

verses.en: It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
verses.pt: Alegria para o justo é fazer justiça; mas isso é pavor para os que praticam maldade.
verses.en_web: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
verses.en_bbe: It is a joy to the good man to do right, but it is destruction to the workers of evil.

verses.en: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.
verses.pt: O homem que se afasta do caminho do entendimento repousará no ajuntamento dos mortos.
verses.en_web: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.
verses.en_bbe: The wanderer from the way of knowledge will have his resting-place among the shades.

verses.en: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.
verses.pt: Quem ama o prazer sofrerá necessidade; aquele que ama o vinho e o azeite nunca enriquecerá.
verses.en_web: He who loves pleasure shall be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil shall not be rich.
verses.en_bbe: The lover of pleasure will be a poor man: the lover of wine and oil will not get wealth.

verses.en: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.
verses.pt: O resgate em troca do justo é o perverso; e no lugar do reto fica o transgressor.
verses.en_web: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous; the treacherous for the upright.
verses.en_bbe: The evil-doer will be given as a price for the life of the good man, and the worker of deceit in the place of the upright.

verses.en: It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.
verses.pt: É melhor morar em terra deserta do que com uma mulher briguenta e que se irrita facilmente.
verses.en_web: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.
verses.en_bbe: It is better to be living in a waste land, than with a bitter-tongued and angry woman.

verses.en: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.
verses.pt: Há tesouro desejável e azeite na casa do sábio; mas o homem tolo é devorador.
verses.en_web: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man swallows it up.
verses.en_bbe: There is a store of great value in the house of the wise, but it is wasted by the foolish man.

verses.en: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.
verses.pt: Quem segue a justiça e a bondade achará vida, justiça e honra.
verses.en_web: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.
verses.en_bbe: He who goes after righteousness and mercy will get life, righteousness, and honour.

verses.en: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.
verses.pt: O sábio passa por cima da cidade dos fortes e derruba a fortaleza em que confiam.
verses.en_web: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.
verses.en_bbe: A wise man goes up into the town of the strong ones, and overcomes its strength in which they put their faith.

verses.en: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.
verses.pt: Quem guarda sua boca e sua língua guarda sua alma de angústias.
verses.en_web: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.
verses.en_bbe: He who keeps watch over his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.

verses.en: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who dealeth in proud wrath.
verses.pt: “Zombador” é o nome do arrogante e orgulhoso; ele trata os outros com uma arrogância irritante.
verses.en_web: The proud and haughty man, “scoffer” is his name; he works in the arrogance of pride.
verses.en_bbe: The man of pride, lifted up in soul, is named high-hearted; he is acting in an outburst of pride.

verses.en: The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.
verses.pt: O desejo do preguiçoso o matará, porque suas mãos se recusam a trabalhar;
verses.en_web: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.
verses.en_bbe: The desire of the hater of work is death to him, for his hands will do no work.

verses.en: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.
verses.pt: Ele fica desejando suas cobiças o dia todo; mas o justo dá, e não deixa de dar.
verses.en_web: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.
verses.en_bbe: All the day the sinner goes after his desire: but the upright man gives freely, keeping nothing back.

verses.en: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind?
verses.pt: O sacrifício dos perversos é abominável; quanto mais quando a oferta é feita com má intenção.
verses.en_web: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination; how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!
verses.en_bbe: The offering of evil-doers is disgusting: how much more when they give it with an evil purpose!

verses.en: A false witness shall perish: but the man that heareth speaketh constantly.
verses.pt: A testemunha mentirosa perecerá; porém o homem que ouve a verdade falará com sucesso.
verses.en_web: A false witness will perish, and a man who listens speaks to eternity.
verses.en_bbe: A false witness will be cut off, ...

verses.en: A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.
verses.pt: O homem perverso endurece seu rosto, mas o correto confirma o seu caminho.
verses.en_web: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.
verses.en_bbe: The evil-doer makes his face hard, but as for the upright, he gives thought to his way.

verses.en: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.
verses.pt: Não há sabedoria, nem entendimento, nem conselho contra o SENHOR.
verses.en_web: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Wisdom and knowledge and wise suggestions are of no use against the Lord.

verses.en: The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of the LORD.
verses.pt: O cavalo é preparado para o dia da batalha, mas a vitória vem do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: The horse is made ready for the day of war, but power to overcome is from the Lord.
